# rhythmCI

A toolkit covering complete circadian data analysis workflow primarily
for Nanostring nCounter data, encompassing everything from importing and
processing to normalization, analysis and visualization. The regression
based analysis for estimating the confidence interval of amplitude is
broadly applicable, not only for gene-expression data, but also for
other biological data. An informative visualization of results accompany
the analysis.

## Installation

You can install the development version of rhythmCI from
[GitHub](https://github.com/Jayanth-Sreekanth/rhythmCI) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Jayanth-Sreekanth/rhythmCI", build = TRUE)
```

Alternatively, installation can be done with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Jayanth-Sreekanth/rhythmCI", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

## Vignettes and Documentation

For detailed examples and workflows, refer to the vignettes:

``` r

# Open the main vignette
vignette("rhythmCI", package="rhythmCI")
```

## Citation

If you use this package in your research, please cite:

> Sreekanth, J., Edel, A., Spies, C., Andreotti, S., &
> Ananthasubramaniam, B. (2026). rhythmCI: an R package for rhythm
> detection using harmonic regression amplitude confidence intervals.
> bioRxiv.

# Package index

## Core Calculations

Main functions for computing rhythm confidence intervals.

- [`rhythmicity()`](https://jayanth-sreekanth.github.io/rhythmCI/reference/rhythmicity.md)
  : Rhythmicity analysis using Harmonic Regression and bootstrapping

## Data Loading and Normalization

Functions for importing raw rhythm data and applying normalization. Use
`normalization = "none"` to load raw datasets directly.

- [`loadnormalizercc()`](https://jayanth-sreekanth.github.io/rhythmCI/reference/loadnormalizercc.md)
  : Load and Normalize Nanostring gene expression data
- [`normalizeruvg()`](https://jayanth-sreekanth.github.io/rhythmCI/reference/normalizeruvg.md)
  : Normalize Nanostring gene expression data

## Visualization

Relative Log Expression (RLE) plots.

- [`create_RLEplot()`](https://jayanth-sreekanth.github.io/rhythmCI/reference/create_RLEplot.md)
  : Create a RLE plot customized to time-series data

## Package Datasets

Built-in datasets included with the package.

- [`simdf`](https://jayanth-sreekanth.github.io/rhythmCI/reference/simdf.md)
  : Simulated Data Frame using simphony
